outcome: The shared accounts/contacts schema and credit-based connectors every other cookbook imports by handle
doneWhen: `accounts` and `contacts` appear as models in the workspace, filed under the GTM folder
neither model has a credential configured: base-gtm deploys zero-config on a fresh workspace

cost.note: Nothing. Native models and adopted connectors; credits are only spent by the cookbooks stacked on top.

invariants.holds: `accounts` keys on website and `contacts` keys on email
invariants.whatBreaks: Every cookbook that promotes into these models dedupes on that key. Change it and overlapping sources fork into duplicate records instead of collapsing.

invariants.holds: No connector here requires a credential
invariants.whatBreaks: Importing a file IS registration in the CDK, so a credentialed connector in base-gtm is deployed by everyone. That is why the CRM lives in crm-sync: someone installing the research agent should not be forced to supply a HubSpot token.
